name: Nikolaus77 Modern Admin Favourites
author: nikolaus77

sections.description:
Nikolaus77 Modern Admin Favourites transforms your daily WordPress workflow by providing a clean, visual, and highly customizable quick-access panel for your most-used admin menu items.

Tired of searching through endless menus every day? This plugin lets you star any top-level or sub-menu item and organize them into custom groups that you can name yourself (e.g., “Content,” “E-commerce,” “SEO Tools”).

Developed by Nikolaus77 (https://nikolay.moscow/).

Key Features

  • Custom Groups & Drag-and-Drop: Create unlimited groups and easily drag favourite items between them. Reorder groups and items exactly how you want. Everything is auto-saved via AJAX.
  • Beautiful Visual Design: Favourites are displayed as modern, colorful gradient buttons with icons, making your most important links instantly recognizable.
  • Dashboard Widget: Access your favourite groups directly from the WordPress dashboard for ultimate convenience. The widget is also fully sortable and respects your group organization.
  • Category Accordion: The full plugin page features an intuitive accordion list of all available menu categories and their sub-items, making it easy to find and star new items.
  • Deterministic Color Palette: Each favourite item is assigned a consistent color based on its unique slug, so it remains visually recognizable even after reordering.
  • Fully Accessible & Responsive: Designed to work beautifully on all screen sizes and built with standard WordPress UI components.

How It Works

  1. Go to the “My Favourites” page in your admin sidebar.
  2. Use the accordion list on the right to find menu items and click the star icon to add them to your first group.
  3. In the “Your Favourites” area, create new groups, rename them, and drag items between groups to organize your workflow.
  4. Enjoy instant access to your personalized menu from both the plugin page and your WordPress dashboard.

All favourites and groups are saved per-user, so each member of your team can have their own personalized admin experience.

Credits

  • Author: Nikolaus77
  • Author Website: https://nikolay.moscow/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the nikolaus77-modern-admin-favourites folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to the new “My Favourites” menu item in your admin sidebar to start organizing your favourite items.
sections.faq:
Who can use this plugin?

Any logged-in user with the read capability (Subscribers and above) can use this plugin. Each user has their own independent favourites and groups stored in their user meta.

Does this plugin slow down my site?

No. All CSS and JavaScript are stored in external files and only loaded on the plugin’s specific admin page and the dashboard. There are no external requests, making it extremely lightweight.

Is the plugin translation-ready?

Yes. It uses standard WordPress internationalization functions and includes a languages folder, making it easy to translate into any language.

Can I recover my favourites if I delete the plugin?

Your favourites and groups are stored in the WordPress database (wp_usermeta table). If you deactivate and delete the plugin, the data will remain. Reinstalling the plugin will restore your favourites.
